lines.text_source: Cursed pest.
lines.speaker: unknown
lines.base_translation: Praga maldita.

lines.text_source: Did you think I'd just sit by while you slipped behind my back?
lines.speaker: unknown
lines.base_translation: Pensou que eu ia ficar de braços cruzados enquanto você passava por trás de mim?
lines.risk_notes: Ratatosk character; tone is menacing. Verify 'slipped behind' translates as intentional action, not physical movement.

lines.text_source: Ugh...
lines.speaker: unknown
lines.base_translation: Ugh...

lines.text_source: Do I look like a Valkyrie to you? A fluttering fool bound to inaction?
lines.speaker: unknown
lines.base_translation: Pareço uma Valquíria pra você? Uma tola tremulante presa à inação?
lines.risk_notes: Ratatosk boasts; 'Valkyrie' references game lore (Valquíria). Tone must preserve scorn.

lines.text_source: No... more like a giant rodent...
lines.speaker: unknown
lines.base_translation: Não... mais como um roedor gigante...

lines.text_source: How dare you?!
lines.speaker: unknown
lines.base_translation: Como ousa?!

lines.text_source: Another bloodsucker...
lines.speaker: unknown
lines.base_translation: Mais um chupa-sangue...

lines.text_source: Alright then, I'll make this quick.
lines.speaker: unknown
lines.base_translation: Certo então, faço isso rápido.

lines.text_source: Step away from them, beast!
lines.speaker: Sirfiel
lines.base_translation: Afastem-se dela, criatura!
lines.risk_notes: Sirfiel criticality=low but commanding tone. Verify formal register without aggression.

lines.text_source: You know... You're starting to become very annoying.
lines.speaker: unknown
lines.base_translation: Sabe... você está ficando muito irritante.
lines.risk_notes: Ratatosk escalates threat. Tone shifts from arrogance to irritation.

lines.text_source: Whatever you say, but touch them and it'll be the last thing you do.
lines.speaker: Sirfiel
lines.base_translation: Fale o que quiser, mas se tocá-los, será a última coisa que fará.
lines.risk_notes: Formal register must convey resolve without becoming familiar. Back-translation check: 'touch them' = 'tocá-los' or 'mexer com eles' — choose form that feels protective, not aggressive.

lines.text_source: Big words for someone so insignificant.
lines.speaker: unknown
lines.base_translation: Palavras grandes para alguém tão insignificante.

lines.text_source: Don't underestimate the power of insignificance, monster.
lines.speaker: Sirfiel
lines.base_translation: Não subestime o poder da insignificância, monstro.
lines.risk_notes: Sirfiel responds with wisdom. 'Insignificance' must not sound weak — reinterpret as strength in humility. Back-translation: preserve paradox.

lines.text_source: What...?
lines.speaker: unknown
lines.base_translation: O quê...?

lines.text_source: You- You heard me!
lines.speaker: Sirfiel
lines.base_translation: Você— você ouviu sim!

lines.text_source: Oh, how I despise you mortals, always punching above your own weight.
lines.speaker: unknown
lines.base_translation: Ah, como odeio vocês mortais, sempre lutando acima do seu próprio nível.

lines.text_source: I don't have time for your nonsense.
lines.speaker: unknown
lines.base_translation: Não tenho tempo pro seu disparate.

lines.text_source: Good, looks like he's gone.
lines.speaker: Sirfiel
lines.base_translation: Bom, parece que ele foi embora.

lines.text_source: I don't think the two of us would have been able to take that thing on.
lines.speaker: Sirfiel
lines.base_translation: Duvido que os dois juntos conseguíssemos enfrentar aquela coisa.
lines.risk_notes: Sirfiel questions shared capability. Tone must convey doubt without undermining character strength. Formal register maintained.

lines.text_source: Melian!
lines.speaker: Sirfiel
lines.base_translation: Melian!

lines.text_source: Melian!
lines.speaker: Sirfiel
lines.base_translation: Melian!

lines.text_source: Melian, can you hear me?!
lines.speaker: Sirfiel
lines.base_translation: Melian, você me ouve?!

lines.text_source: I knew you'd picked up the other volcanic pendant. Melian, how could you? Why did you have to get involved in this by yourself? You don't need to prove anything!
lines.speaker: Sirfiel
lines.base_translation: Eu sabia que você tinha pegado o outro pendente vulcânico. Melian, como pôde? Por que teve que se envolver nisso sozinha? Você não precisa provar nada!
lines.risk_notes: Long emotional scene; lore-critical (death of parents revealed). 'volcanic pendant' = glossary term. Maintain formal tone while conveying passion. Back-translation mandatory.

lines.text_source: Heh... Look at me... Relying on you again, as always. You must be fed up of it. You should just leave me here, I'll be less of a burden on you and the rest.
lines.speaker: unknown
lines.base_translation: Heh... Olha pra mim... Sempre contando com você, como sempre. Você deve estar cansado disso. Você deveria me deixar aqui, serei menos fardo pra você e pros outros.
lines.risk_notes: Melian reveals dependency and self-doubt. Tone must convey shame without becoming melodramatic. First major emotional moment for character.

lines.text_source: Don't ever say that again! You know that you're all I have left since mum and dad died. I don't want... I don't want the same thing to happen with you. You hear me?!
lines.speaker: Sirfiel
lines.base_translation: Nunca diga isso de novo! Você sabe que é tudo o que me sobrou depois que mãe e pai morreram. Eu não quero... Eu não quero que a mesma coisa aconteça com você. Você está me ouvindo?!
lines.risk_notes: Core emotional beat — sister reveals fear of loss after parents' death. Major spoiler/identity moment. Formal tone + passion must balance. Back-translation + QA check mandatory.

lines.text_source: I miss them too... Is that why they never ask me to join in? So that you can take care of me?
lines.speaker: unknown
lines.base_translation: Eu também sinto falta deles... É por isso que eles nunca me pedem pra participar? Pra que você cuide de mim?
lines.risk_notes: Melian processes grief and asks why she's excluded. Tone must be soft, not bitter. Identity as younger/weaker sister implications — preserve ambiguity re: emotional state.

lines.text_source: No, idiot... It's because I only feel protected when you're around, because I know that no one would worry about me like you would.
lines.speaker: Sirfiel
lines.base_translation: Não, idiota... É porque só me sinto protegida quando você está perto, porque sei que ninguém se preocuparia comigo do jeito que você faz.
lines.risk_notes: Sirfiel reveals emotional dependence on Melian. Tone shifts to vulnerability while maintaining formality. Back-translation: 'protected' must mean emotional security, not physical.

lines.text_source: I didn't know... I suppose it's painful to talk about it. Looks like all we have is each other, right?
lines.speaker: unknown
lines.base_translation: Eu não sabia... Acho que é difícil falar sobre isso. Parece que só nos temos um ao outro, né?
lines.risk_notes: Melian accepts emotional truth. Tone shifts from guilt to acceptance. Must sound mature, not dismissive.

lines.text_source: Don't ever do this to me again... From now on, we'll take care of each other, just as mum and dad want. Deal?
lines.speaker: Sirfiel
lines.base_translation: Nunca mais faça isso comigo... De agora em diante, cuidaremos um do outro, como mãe e pai gostariam. Combinado?
lines.risk_notes: Sisters make pact honoring parents' values. Formal tone must convey solemnity of promise. 'mum and dad want' = reference to parental guidance/ghost of values — preserve respect.

lines.text_source: You and me against the world. Doesn't sound too bad... Deal.
lines.speaker: unknown
lines.base_translation: Você e eu contra o mundo. Não soa tão ruim assim... Combinado.
lines.risk_notes: Melian seals pact. Tone: determined but younger-sounding. 'Against the world' idiom localizes as 'você e eu contra o mundo'.

lines.text_source: We should head back. If we don't take care of these wounds soon, they could get serious.
lines.speaker: Sirfiel
lines.base_translation: Devemos voltar. Se não cuidarmos desses ferimentos logo, podem ficar sérios.
lines.risk_notes: Sirfiel shifts to pragmatism after emotional scene. Tone: commanding but caring. 'wounds' must convey injury seriousness.

lines.text_source: You're coming too, soldier.
lines.speaker: Sirfiel
lines.base_translation: Você também vem, soldado.

lines.text_source: Sirfiel, wait.
lines.speaker: unknown
lines.base_translation: Sirfiel, espera.

lines.text_source: Friend... You must stop him.
lines.speaker: unknown
lines.base_translation: Amiga... Você precisa detê-lo.
lines.risk_notes: Melian addresses 'Friend' (player character). Mission-critical request — must convey urgency and weight of ask without melodrama.

lines.text_source: Are you crazy?
lines.speaker: Sirfiel
lines.base_translation: Você pirou?

lines.text_source: You want to go after that monster?
lines.speaker: Sirfiel
lines.base_translation: Você quer ir atrás daquele monstro?

lines.text_source: Sirfiel, it's important. Something terrible will happen if nobody stops him.
lines.speaker: unknown
lines.base_translation: Sirfiel, é importante. Algo terrível vai acontecer se ninguém detê-lo.
lines.risk_notes: Melian justifies dangerous mission. Tone: serious but not hysterical. 'something terrible' = vague foreshadowing — preserve ambiguity for pacing.

lines.text_source: I don't know what you've got yourself into, but we can't send reinforcements here, I don't have enough materials for more amulets either. You best be extra cautious if you plan to face that monster and come back in one piece.
lines.speaker: Sirfiel
lines.base_translation: Não sei em que você se meteu, mas não posso mandar reforços aqui, também não tenho material suficiente pra mais amuletos. É melhor você ser bem cuidadoso se planeja enfrentar aquele monstro e voltar inteira.
lines.risk_notes: Sirfiel briefs player on resource constraints and danger. Formal-military tone; must convey both limitation and support. 'reinforcements/amulets' = lore terms. Long line — verify byte budget.

lines.text_source: Come closer, friend, I have to tell you something...
lines.speaker: unknown
lines.base_translation: Chegue mais perto, amiga, preciso contar algo pra você...
lines.risk_notes: Melian asks to speak privately with player. Tone must convey trust and secrecy. Setup for major plot revelation.

lines.text_source: I can't use this anymore. I'd like you to keep it and continue what we've started. You know what's at stake...
lines.speaker: unknown
lines.base_translation: Não posso mais usar isso. Gostaria que você ficasse com isso e continuasse o que começamos. Você sabe o que está em jogo...
lines.risk_notes: Melian passes critical artifact/responsibility to player — mission-defining moment. Tone: solemn, not defeated. 'what we've started' = shared quest. Back-translation mandatory.

lines.text_source: You haven't let go of that orb since you found it. Will that be enough to save him?
lines.speaker: Sirfiel
lines.base_translation: Você não soltou aquele orbe desde que encontrou. Isso será o suficiente pra salvá-lo?
lines.risk_notes: Sirfiel questions artifact's sufficiency to save someone. Tone: loving but doubtful. 'that orb' = lore term (volcanic orb?). Worry must be genuine.

lines.text_source: Don't worry, sister. He knows how to take care of himself.
lines.speaker: unknown
lines.base_translation: Não se preocupe, irmã. Ele sabe cuidar de si mesmo.

lines.text_source: Alright...
lines.speaker: Sirfiel
lines.base_translation: Certo...

lines.text_source: We're leaving. Come back soon or I'll have to worry Brigard.
lines.speaker: Sirfiel
lines.base_translation: Estamos indo. Volte logo ou vou ter que preocupar o Brigard.
lines.risk_notes: Sirfiel says goodbye with implicit concern (threat to worry Brigard = care metric). 'come back soon' = implied danger. Formal tone + concern balance.

lines.text_source: Look at it. The gift of the Gods, Yggdrasil.
lines.speaker: unknown
lines.base_translation: Veja só. O presente dos Deuses, Yggdrasil.
lines.risk_notes: Ratatosk enters boss-fight monologue mode. Tone shifts to grandiose/apocalyptic. 'Yggdrasil' = lore term (world tree). Preserve mythic weight.

lines.text_source: Some worship it, others fear it.
lines.speaker: unknown
lines.base_translation: Alguns a adoram, outros a temem.

lines.text_source: But wherever it is, this tree has the ability to change the fate of the world.
lines.speaker: unknown
lines.base_translation: Mas onde quer que esteja, essa árvore tem o poder de mudar o destino do mundo.
lines.risk_notes: Ratatosk reveals stakes — world-changing power. Tone: grandiose/biblical. 'fate of the world' = ultimate consequence.

lines.text_source: Even in Terragaya, where it has stayed hidden for millennia.
lines.speaker: unknown
lines.base_translation: Até em Terragaya, onde permaneceu oculta por milênios.
lines.risk_notes: Ratatosk reveals location — Terragaya (lore term, glossary: verbatim). 'hidden for millennia' = suggests ancient conspiracy. Tone: secret keeper's gloat.

lines.text_source: What are you doing here, mortal?
lines.speaker: unknown
lines.base_translation: O que você faz aqui, mortal?

lines.text_source: You're in such a rush to die that you can't wait until I'm done with Yggdrasil?
lines.speaker: unknown
lines.base_translation: Está com tanta pressa de morrer que não consegue esperar até eu terminar com Yggdrasil?
lines.risk_notes: Ratatosk mocks player's urgency. 'dying' = suicide rush implication. Tone: villainous gloat.

lines.text_source: Alright. If that's what you want, you'll get one chance to stop me.
lines.speaker: unknown
lines.base_translation: Certo. Se é isso que quer, terá uma chance de me deter.
lines.risk_notes: Ratatosk grants player 'one chance.' Tone: magnanimous monster offering mercy.

lines.text_source: After this, I'll bite its roots and everything will end.
lines.speaker: unknown
lines.base_translation: Depois disso, morderei suas raízes e tudo terminará.
lines.risk_notes: Ratatosk states final action. 'bite its roots' = literal apocalyptic act. Tone: unstoppable force of nature.

lines.text_source: Show me the determination that brought you here! Defend yourself!
lines.speaker: unknown
lines.base_translation: Mostre-me a determinação que te trouxe aqui! Defenda-se!
lines.risk_notes: Boss battle line — Ratatosk taunts player to prove themselves. Tone: contemptuous but respecting opponent's arrival.

lines.text_source: Ugh...
lines.speaker: unknown
lines.base_translation: Ugh...

lines.text_source: I hope you know the consequences of what you've avoided here...
lines.speaker: unknown
lines.base_translation: Espero que você saiba as consequências do que evitou aqui...
lines.risk_notes: Ratatosk, defeated, warns of consequences. Tone: bitter, not apologetic. 'avoided here' = suggests larger threat deferred, not solved. Foreshadowing.

lines.text_source: If you're that desperate to find the Guardian, I'll tell you where he is.
lines.speaker: unknown
lines.base_translation: Se você é desesperada o suficiente pra procurar o Guardião, vou te contar onde ele está.
lines.risk_notes: Ratatosk offers information about Guardian (lore term). Tone: grudging respect + scorn.

lines.text_source: Head east until you reach a large platform. On it, place this cube. It's a key. It'll take you to the place you're looking for.
lines.speaker: unknown
lines.base_translation: Vá leste até chegar a uma grande plataforma. Nela, coloque este cubo. É uma chave. Ela te levará ao lugar que procura.
lines.risk_notes: Ratatosk gives crucial directions to Guardian. Long expository line. 'cube' = artifact term. Tone: matter-of-fact despite defeat. 'place' = ritual instruction.

lines.text_source: Now it's on you to fix this.
lines.speaker: unknown
lines.base_translation: Agora é com você consertar isso.
lines.risk_notes: Ratatosk's final line — passes burden to player. Tone: resignation + dark prediction. 'fix this' = suggests damage beyond boss fight.

lines.text_source: What an unfortunate sight... I don't think you're capable of finishing off those roots right now.
lines.speaker: unknown
lines.base_translation: Que visão desoladora... Não acredito que sejam capazes de destruir essas raízes agora.

lines.text_source: I suppose those mortals weren't following me for the sake of it....
lines.speaker: unknown
lines.base_translation: Suponho que esses mortais não me seguiam à toa...

lines.text_source: What will happen with the plague now if you don't destroy the tree? And why have you given that Human the key to Beigon?
lines.speaker: unknown
lines.base_translation: O que acontecerá com a praga se não destruírem a árvore? E por que deram a chave de Beigon ao Humano?
lines.risk_notes: múltiplas linhas de raciocínio; quebra de sintaxe pt-BR natural

lines.text_source: You know very well what will happen. You yourself have seen how unstoppable it is. At this rate, it'll wipe everything out, and it'll be just a matter of time before it reaches the Sea of Oberon.
lines.speaker: unknown
lines.base_translation: Você sabe muito bem o que acontecerá. Já viu como é imparável. Neste ritmo, varrará tudo e será só uma questão de tempo até chegar ao Mar de Oberon.
lines.risk_notes: registro formal elevado; preservar tom de gravidade

lines.text_source: They're that afraid of it?
lines.speaker: unknown
lines.base_translation: Têm tanto medo assim?

lines.text_source: You've instilled those little mortals with so much confidence, at least get them to the end. The plague's origin lies there. That's why I took the key, so no one could open the Guardian's chamber. But I'm guessing you knew all that...
lines.speaker: unknown
lines.base_translation: Você inspirou tanta confiança nesses pequenos mortais, pelo menos leve-os até o fim. A origem da praga está lá. Por isso peguei a chave, para ninguém abrir a câmara do Guardião. Mas imagino que já sabia disso...
lines.risk_notes: linha longa com múltiplas cláusulas; revisar naturalidade pt-BR; risco de spoiler em 'a origem da praga'

lines.text_source: Are you sure about this?
lines.speaker: unknown
lines.base_translation: Tem certeza disso?

lines.text_source: My nose never fails me. Now it's up to you to do something.
lines.speaker: unknown
lines.base_translation: Meu olfato nunca me falha. Agora você precisa fazer algo.

lines.text_source: Huh?
lines.speaker: npc
lines.base_translation: Hã?

lines.text_source: So it's still not over then?
lines.speaker: npc
lines.base_translation: Então ainda não acabou?

lines.text_source: Alright, I wouldn't want to disappoint..
lines.speaker: npc
lines.base_translation: Tá certo, não quero decepcionar.

lines.text_source: First that monster and now you.
lines.speaker: npc
lines.base_translation: Primeiro aquele monstro e agora você.

lines.text_source: Did it really have to end like this...?
lines.speaker: npc
lines.base_translation: Precisava terminar assim mesmo...?

lines.text_source: Soooldier... No kiiill...
lines.speaker: unknown
lines.base_translation: Sooolddado... Sem... matar...
lines.risk_notes: entidade antiga com fala distorcida; localizar interjeição 'Soldado' em pt-BR sobrenatural

lines.text_source: Soul want play gaaame...
lines.speaker: unknown
lines.base_translation: Almmma quer jooogar...
lines.risk_notes: ênfase em 'gaaame' → 'jogo' com prolongamento

lines.text_source: Guess chest with rewaaard...
lines.speaker: unknown
lines.base_translation: Adivinha o bauu com recompennsa...

lines.text_source: If right many tiiime... soul give giiiift...
lines.speaker: unknown
lines.base_translation: Se acertar muitas vezzzes... almmma dá donnnativo...

lines.text_source: Soul give giiift...
lines.speaker: unknown
lines.base_translation: Almmma dá donnnativo...

lines.text_source: But if wrooong... must kiiill...
lines.speaker: unknown
lines.base_translation: Mas se errrrrar... deve matar...

lines.text_source: Want giiift...?
lines.speaker: unknown
lines.base_translation: Quer donnnativo...?

lines.text_source: Choose wiiiisely...
lines.speaker: unknown
lines.base_translation: Escolha com cuidado...

lines.text_source: Soul waaiit until change miiind...
lines.speaker: unknown
lines.base_translation: Almmma espera até você mudar de ideia...

lines.text_source: If right many tiiime... soul give giiiift...
lines.speaker: unknown
lines.base_translation: Se acertar muitas vezzzes... almmma dá donnnativo...

lines.text_source: But if wrooong... must kiiill...
lines.speaker: unknown
lines.base_translation: Mas se errrrrar... deve matar...

lines.text_source: Want giiift...?
lines.speaker: unknown
lines.base_translation: Quer donnnativo...?

lines.text_source: Must kiiilll...
lines.speaker: unknown
lines.base_translation: Deve mataaaar...

lines.text_source: Gift cloooser...
lines.speaker: unknown
lines.base_translation: Donnnativo maaais perto...

lines.text_source: Do... very weeell...
lines.speaker: unknown
lines.base_translation: Faz... muitooo bemmm...

lines.text_source: Enjoy giiift...
lines.speaker: unknown
lines.base_translation: Aproveita donnnativo...

lines.text_source: I know why heeere...
lines.speaker: unknown
lines.base_translation: Sei por que vieeeu...

lines.text_source: Was... surpriiise?
lines.speaker: unknown
lines.base_translation: Foi... surpreeesa?
lines.risk_notes: possível spoiler implícito

lines.text_source: Is okay if don't waaant play this tiiime...
lines.speaker: unknown
lines.base_translation: Tá bemmm se não quiser jogar desta veeeez...

lines.text_source: Soul... is...
lines.speaker: unknown
lines.base_translation: Almmma... é...
lines.risk_notes: frase incompleta sugere revelação; risco de spoiler

lines.text_source: ready...
lines.speaker: unknown
lines.base_translation: pronto...
lines.risk_notes: palavra incompleta; revisar se deve manter 'ready' ou interpretar contexto
